title: 实验室安全制度：写在纸上，做在手上（国内版）
source_doc: course/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/11_Module 2 — The OSHA Laboratory Standard.md
author_source: project/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/11_Module 2 — The OSHA Laboratory Standard（国内版）/src.py

points.K4: 同样的化学品，不同的管法
points.K13: 泄漏后，在场的人都要关注
points.K16: 制度跟上实验室的变化
points.S1: 三级管理与安全责任人

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着一本空白安全手册，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a thick blank safety manual and waves at the camera in a tidy lab.
shots.narration: 这一课讲实验室安全制度。
overlay: 实验室安全制度：写在纸上，做在手上

shots.scene: 法规书、学校制度、实验室手册三本书由大到小摞在一起
shots.prompt_en: Three blank books stacked from large to small: a national law book, a university rules book and a lab safety manual. No people.
shots.narration: 从国家法规，到学校制度，再到实验室手册。

shots.scene: 王老师来检查，老周从柜子顶上翻出一本落灰的手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator arrives for an inspection while the older man pulls a dusty blank manual down from the top of a cabinet.
shots.narration: 王老师来检查，老周翻出一本旧手册。

shots.scene: 手册里的责任人照片是一位已毕业的学生，化学品清单很旧
shots.prompt_en: The open manual shows a blank contact card with an old graduation cap icon and an outdated short chemical list. No people.
shots.narration: 里面的安全员早毕业了，清单也是旧的。

shots.scene: 王老师指向实验台上一排新试剂，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a row of new reagent bottles on the bench and shakes his head.
shots.narration: 新买的危险试剂，手册里一个字都没有。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 制度写在纸上，更要做在手上。

shots.scene: 法规书、学校制度、实验室手册三层图标
shots.prompt_en: Three layered icons: a law book with a national emblem shape, a university building with a rule book, and a lab door with a manual. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室安全，有一整套制度可循。

shots.scene: 空白手册翻开，浮现规程、培训、检查三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The blank manual opens and three icons float out: a procedure sheet, a training board and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 它规定了安全的实验室该是什么样。

shots.scene: 原片案例图标：国外实验室门口一张罚单
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lab door with a large blank penalty notice taped to it. No people.
shots.narration: 原片案例：国外一家研发实验室被重罚。

shots.scene: 旧手册、退休的负责人、过时的培训三张卡片
shots.prompt_en: Three cards: a dusty old manual, an empty office chair for a retired manager, and an outdated training slide. No people.
shots.narration: 手册多年没改，负责人早退休，培训过时。

shots.scene: 新试剂瓶带着自燃和健康危害标识，旁边空着没有规程
shots.prompt_en: New reagent bottles with flame-over-circle and health hazard pictograms sit beside an empty space where a procedure should be. No people.
shots.narration: 新用的高危试剂，没有规程和专区。

shots.scene: 文件和现实之间裂开一道缝
shots.prompt_en: A gap opening between a document icon and a real lab icon, with a red warning mark in the gap. No people.
shots.narration: 纸上和现实脱节，问题就出在这里。

shots.scene: 四张空白卡片：实验规模、多种化学品、非生产、有防护
shots.prompt_en: Four blank cards in a row: a small flask, several bottles, a crossed-out factory, and goggles with gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 原片说，国外按几项条件判断适用范围。

shots.scene: 王老师在实验室门口挂上空白分级标识牌
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hangs a blank classification sign with a colored level marker beside a lab door.
shots.narration: 国内高校按危险源分类分级管理。

shots.scene: 红、橙、黄、蓝四个等级的门牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Four lab door sign icons in red, orange, yellow and blue. No people.
shots.narration: 危险越高，管控要求越严。

shots.section_title: 同样的化学品，不同的管法
shots.scene: 同一栋楼里相邻的两间实验室，摆着同样的试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: Two adjacent lab rooms in the same building with the same reagent bottles on their benches. No people.
shots.narration: 隔壁两间屋，用着同样的化学品，
overlay: 同样的化学品，不同的管法

shots.section_title: 同样的化学品，不同的管法
shots.scene: 左边做探索实验，右边做固定检测，箭头指向不同的规则本
shots.prompt_en: The left room shows varied experiments with many flasks, the right room shows repeated fixed tests in a row; arrows point to two different rule books. No people.
shots.narration: 干的活不一样，管理要求也不同。

shots.section_title: 同样的化学品，不同的管法
shots.scene: 欣欣指着两间屋
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the two rooms one after the other.
shots.narration: 看的是你实际在做什么。

shots.scene: 实验室安全手册像电脑操作系统一样，连着各个设备图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank lab safety manual icon at the center connected like an operating system to icons of a fume hood, bottles, people and a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室安全手册，就像实验室的操作系统。

shots.scene: 手册里列着已经拆掉的通风橱和没人用的化学品，被红圈
shots.prompt_en: Pages of a blank manual listing an icon of a removed fume hood and bottles nobody uses, circled in red. No people.
shots.narration: 写着拆掉的设备、没人用的试剂，不行。

shots.scene: 老周修改手册，阿杰和小研在旁边签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man updates the blank manual while the female graduate student and the young male student sign beside him.
shots.narration: 它是实验室和每个人之间的约定，

shots.scene: 手册和实验室一起变化的循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A circular arrow linking the manual and the lab, both updating together. No people.
shots.narration: 要制定，更要执行，跟着实验室一起变。

shots.scene: 空白手册翻开，目录上有八个图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank manual opened to a contents page with eight small icons. No people.
shots.narration: 一本好的安全手册，常有这些内容：

shots.scene: 规程本、通风橱、护目镜手套三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a procedure book, a fume hood and goggles with gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 操作规程、控制措施、防护要求。

shots.scene: 培训黑板、审批章、医院十字三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a training board, an approval stamp and a medical cross. No people.
shots.narration: 培训准入、危险实验审批、健康与就医。

shots.scene: 安全员胸牌和上锁的专柜两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a blank safety officer badge and a locked special cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 明确安全员，高危化学品特别管理。

shots.scene: 老李检测通风橱，贴上空白检测标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer measures a fume hood with an airflow meter and sticks a blank inspection tag on it.
shots.narration: 通风橱听着在转，不等于合格。

shots.scene: 没有检测标签的通风橱旁一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood without any inspection tag, with a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 定期检测、有记录有标识，才算数。

shots.scene: 骷髅、健康危害、爆炸三个标识的瓶子放进上锁的专柜
shots.prompt_en: Bottles with skull and crossbones, health hazard and exploding bomb pictograms placed into a locked special cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 剧毒、易制毒、易制爆等管控化学品，

shots.scene: 专柜前两把锁、两个人形
shots.prompt_en: A special cabinet with two locks and two person pictograms each holding a key. No people.
shots.narration: 专柜专区，双人双锁，出入登记。

shots.scene: 一小瓶和一大桶都放进专柜，等号连起来
shots.prompt_en: A tiny vial and a large drum both going into the locked cabinet, joined by an equals sign. No people.
shots.narration: 看的是物质本身，不是用量多少。

shots.scene: 专柜旁的专用废物桶
shots.prompt_en: A dedicated labeled waste container beside the locked special cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 废弃物也要按专门规定处理。

shots.scene: 实验室空气中飘着分子，旁边一条限值红线
shots.prompt_en: Molecule icons floating in a lab air space next to a gauge with a red limit line. No people.
shots.narration: 空气里的有毒物质，有接触限值。

shots.scene: 实验室图标没有豁免章
shots.prompt_en: A lab room icon with a crossed-out exemption stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室不是例外，同样要遵守。

shots.scene: 限值红线下面还有一条黄色预警线
shots.prompt_en: Below the red limit line there is a yellow warning line on the gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 接近限值，就该加强监测和防护。

shots.scene: 小研在通风橱里做大量溶剂萃取，旁边空气采样器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works with large solvent bottles inside a fume hood while a small air sampling device sits nearby.
shots.narration: 大量使用挥发性溶剂，怀疑超标，

shots.scene: 老李拿着空气检测仪在实验室采样
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer takes an air sample in the lab with a handheld detector.
shots.narration: 就请专业人员检测空气。

shots.scene: 日历上标出复测日期
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with a follow-up date circled. No people.
shots.narration: 结果偏高，改进措施并定期复测。

shots.scene: 王老师把空白检测报告发给实验室每个人
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands copies of a blank test report to everyone in the lab.
shots.narration: 检测结果，要及时告知实验室的人。

shots.scene: 报告锁在档案柜里落灰，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A test report locked in a dusty file cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 锁在柜子里不告诉大家，不行。

shots.scene: 只有签名的签到表，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A sign-in sheet with only signatures, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 签了到，不等于受了培训。

shots.scene: 阿杰参加培训后在电脑上答题，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes a safety quiz on a computer with a blank screen after a training session.
shots.narration: 学完要考核，合格才能进实验室。

shots.scene: 阿杰签空白安全承诺书，拿到门禁卡
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank safety commitment form and receives a lab access card.
shots.narration: 签安全承诺书，才拿到准入资格。

shots.scene: 培训记录卡上：姓名、日期、内容、讲师、成绩
shots.prompt_en: A blank training record card with five rows of icons: a person, a calendar, a book, a teacher and a score. No people.
shots.narration: 记录要写清学了什么、谁讲的、考得怎样。

shots.section_title: 泄漏后，在场的人都要关注
shots.scene: 实验室地上一小摊泄漏，三个人在屋里
shots.prompt_en: A small chemical spill on a lab floor with three people in the room: the female graduate student, the young male student and the older man.
shots.narration: 实验室发生了化学品泄漏，屋里有三人。
overlay: 泄漏后，在场的人都要关注

shots.section_title: 泄漏后，在场的人都要关注
shots.scene: 只有阿杰扶着额头说头疼
shots.prompt_en: Only the young male student holds his forehead with a headache; the other two look fine.
shots.narration: 只有一个人说头疼。

shots.section_title: 泄漏后，在场的人都要关注
shots.scene: 三个人都去校医院，老周陪同
shots.prompt_en: All three walk together toward a clinic building with a red cross.
shots.narration: 可在场的人都可能接触，都该评估就医。

shots.section_title: 泄漏后，在场的人都要关注
shots.scene: 王老师在空白记录本上登记
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator writes the names of everyone present in a blank incident logbook.
shots.narration: 谁在现场、怎么处理的，都要记下来。

shots.scene: 王老师带队走进实验室检查，拿着空白检查表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads an inspection team into a lab holding a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 安全检查，既看现场，

shots.scene: 检查员和小研单独交谈
shots.prompt_en: An inspector talks one-on-one with the female graduate student in a quiet corner.
shots.narration: 也会单独问问实验室的人。

shots.scene: 桌上摊开手册、培训记录、检测记录
shots.prompt_en: A table with a blank safety manual, a training record binder and a test record binder laid out. No people.
shots.narration: 手册、培训、检测记录，一样样核对。

shots.scene: 空白整改通知单
shots.prompt_en: A blank rectification notice with a deadline box. No people.
shots.narration: 发现问题，限期整改。

shots.scene: 档案室一排排档案盒
shots.prompt_en: Rows of blank archive boxes on shelves in a records room. No people.
shots.narration: 健康和接触记录，要长期保存。

shots.scene: 旧电脑的数据迁移到新电脑
shots.prompt_en: Data arrows moving from an old computer to a new computer. No people.
shots.narration: 人走了、系统换了，记录不能丢。

shots.section_title: 制度跟上实验室的变化
shots.scene: 欣欣举着手册和实验室照片对比
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank manual next to a picture of the current lab, comparing them.
shots.narration: 检查明天就来，你的手册和现实一致吗？
overlay: 制度跟上实验室的变化

shots.section_title: 制度跟上实验室的变化
shots.scene: 手册里新增一页，新试剂瓶图标加入
shots.prompt_en: A new page is added to the manual with icons of the new reagent bottles. No people.
shots.narration: 新试剂写进去了吗？培训跟上了吗？

shots.section_title: 制度跟上实验室的变化
shots.scene: 落灰的书被红叉，旁边一本带日历的手册打勾
shots.prompt_en: A dusty static book crossed out with a red X beside a manual with a calendar and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 一成不变的制度，迟早会失效。

shots.section_title: 三级管理与安全责任人
shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三层楼图标从上到下
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked building icons from top to bottom: a university, a department and a lab room. No people.
shots.narration: 国内高校实行三级管理：
overlay: 三级管理与安全责任人

shots.section_title: 三级管理与安全责任人
shots.scene: 老周站在实验室门口的空白安全责任牌旁
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands beside a blank safety responsibility board at the lab door.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人是安全第一责任人。

shots.section_title: 三级管理与安全责任人
shots.scene: 小研戴上空白安全员袖标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a blank safety officer armband.
shots.narration: 实验室设安全员，日常管起来。

shots.scene: 阿杰对照手册检查自己的实验台
shots.prompt_en: The young male student checks his own bench against the blank safety manual.
shots.narration: 谁使用，谁负责。

shots.scene: 遵守制度、规范操作、报告隐患三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a rule book, a correct procedure, and a warning report form. No people.
shots.narration: 守制度、按规程，发现隐患及时报告。

shots.scene: 老周和小研对着空白应急预案讨论
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student discuss a blank emergency plan on the wall.
shots.narration: 实验室要有应急预案，

shots.scene: 大家在走廊里进行疏散演练
shots.prompt_en: Lab members walk calmly toward an emergency exit sign during an evacuation drill.
shots.narration: 定期演练，真出事才不慌。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁写着119和120
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon beside a fire icon and a red cross icon. No people.
shots.narration: 火警119，急救120，再报告学校。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现法规、制度、手册三本书
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three floating blank books: a law book, a university rule book and a lab manual.
shots.narration: 法规、学校制度、实验室手册层层落实。

shots.scene: 手册和实验室的循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A circular arrow linking the manual and the lab. No people.
shots.narration: 手册跟着实验室变，不当摆设。

shots.scene: 门禁卡、上锁专柜、检测标签三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab access card, a locked special cabinet and an inspection tag. No people.
shots.narration: 培训准入、专柜专管、设施有检测。

shots.scene: 检测报告、就医、档案盒三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a test report, a clinic cross and an archive box. No people.
shots.narration: 结果要告知，暴露要就医，记录要保存。

shots.scene: 欣欣合上手册挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot closes the blank safety manual and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 制度做在手上，下次见！
